description: The most recently posted roles, optionally narrowed by city, country, location text, category, kind of firm or ready-made list. Good for "what is new this week".

category.description: Role type, one of: Trading, Research, Investment Banking, Mergers & Acquisitions, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Asset Management, Strategy Consulting, Technology, Business & Operations, General

city.description: A city page slug or name, e.g. london, newyork, amsterdam (see list_cities)

country.description: ISO2 code or country name, e.g. NL, GB, "United Kingdom"

kind.description: Kind of firm slug, e.g. hedge-funds, investment-banks, proprietary-trading-firms (see list_companies)

list.description: A ready-made list slug from browse_lists, e.g. quant-roles, united-kingdom

location.description: Free-text city or country substring, e.g. "Amsterdam", "Netherlands"

name: latest_jobs
title: Newest roles
